name: study-stash-promo
description: Study Stash's promotional video, built with Remotion

scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical
scripts.render2: remotion render src/index.ts Promo2 out/promo2.mp4 && python3 scripts/master.py out/promo2.mp4
scripts.render2:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts Promo2Vertical out/promo2-vertical.mp4 && python3 scripts/master.py out/promo2-vertical.mp4
scripts.render2:all: npm run render2 && npm run render2:vertical
scripts.render3: remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/demo.mp4 && python3 scripts/master.py out/demo.mp4
scripts.render3:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts DemoVertical out/demo-vertical.mp4 && python3 scripts/master.py out/demo-vertical.mp4
scripts.render3:all: npm run render3 && npm run render3:vertical
